Container.Name: media-audit
Container.Overview: Scans your media library (read-only) and reports what's actually in it: size per movie/show/season, and container, codecs, resolution, HDR10/HDR10+/Dolby Vision, Atmos/DTS:X, audio and subtitle languages and release group for every file.[br][br]Each start runs one scan and the container then stops; press Start (or schedule "docker start media-audit" with User Scripts) to rescan. Rescans only re-read new or changed files.[br][br]On the very first start it writes /config/config.yml from the folders it finds under /media and stops without scanning, so you can review the library list first.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Config file and SQLite database. Keep this on the cache/appdata share, not on the media array.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Folder containing your libraries (e.g. movies/, tv/). Mounted read-only; media-audit never modifies files.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the scanner runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the scanner runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: Scan workers
Config.Description: Files analyzed in parallel. Keep low (1-4) for array disks.
